visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in front of a MUJI storefront. A person wearing dark clothing stands before wooden shelves stocked with various household goods. Large pink and white text overlays dominate the screen, announcing a guide to five new MUJI products. The setting is a brightly lit shopping mall corridor. (2) Inside the store, the camera focuses on the skincare section. A hand reaches out and picks up a transparent pump bottle of MUJI's 'Moisturizing Milk' from a wooden shelf. Nearby bottles and sample testers are neatly organized under bright studio-style lighting. (3) The scene shifts to the cosmetics area. A hand holds a tube of lip gloss and swatches two distinct shades—a soft pink and a reddish-brown—onto the back of the hand to demonstrate the glossy texture. The background shows blurred displays of other makeup products. (4) The camera pans across a rack of beige and black strap sandals. A hand pulls a light gray pair forward for a closer look. Subsequently, a close-up shows a person's foot wearing the sandal, stepping on a light-colored wooden floor to demonstrate the look and fit. (5) In the accessories department, the hand picks up a pair of round-frame sunglasses from a display where items are packed in brown paper pouches. Different lens colors are visible on the rack. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the store interior. (6) The focus moves to clothing, specifically a rack of gauze fabric trousers. A hand touches and feels the white textured fabric. Rows of similar pants in white, gray, and navy blue hang in the background, creating a minimalist aesthetic. (7) A wide shot captures the expansive MUJI store interior with wooden furniture and organized displays. A text overlay encourages viewers to share the video with fellow fans. The store appears clean and orderly with no other people in focus. (8) The final shot is a pink graphic screen displaying the 'Japanuts' logo and various social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Text encourages the audience to like, comment, and follow the link in the bio.
